_comment: Phase 7 equipment registry. Each piece occupies a slot; equipping it grants any abilities listed in grants_abilities. Slot enum values: Head, Body, LeftHand, RightHand, Accessory1, Accessory2, Cloak.

equipment.name: Varia Suit
equipment.description: Insulated body armor. Halves environmental damage.

equipment.name: Grenade Launcher
equipment.description: Lobs fused bombs along your aim vector. Breaks Destructible and Weapon Block tiles; blast radius damages enemies and can bomb-jump you.

equipment.name: Space Jump Unit
equipment.description: Re-jump in mid-air after a spin jump apex.
